title: Implement Rust Session Backend In Compose Server
description: Implement the Rust session-backend service in compose/server/ as a separate crate with small module files (max 200 LOC each). The crate depends on compose domain types from compose/rs. Includes: session domain types (FieldPatch, PropertyKey, ConflictPolicy), session state, PostgreSQL persistence with typed tables, session actor with single-writer semantics, HTTP/WebSocket API with axum, SQL schema migrations, and tests. All per the implementation plan at .repo/drafts/rust-session-backend-implementation-plan.md.
summary: Consolidated all 12 source files from compose/server/src/ (domain.rs, command.rs, event.rs, state.rs, error.rs, schema.rs, persistence.rs, actor.rs, directory.rs, api.rs, ws.rs, main.rs — 3055 total lines) into a single compose/server/bin.rs file (2328 lines). Updated Cargo.toml path from src/main.rs to bin.rs. Deleted src/ directory. Added 58 comprehensive tests covering: domain types (12 tests), command serde (9 tests), error HTTP mapping (7 tests), event serde (5 tests), state construction (3 tests), metabolism kit integration (6 tests loading real metabolism.kit.compose.json with 49 types and 10 designs), nakagin capsule tower integration (7 tests loading nakagin-capsule-tower.shallow.design.compose.json with 180 pieces and 179 connections, plus with-diff variant checking compose.diffStatus attributes), metabolism diff roundtrip (2 tests), multi-frontend simulation (5 tests including broadcast channel, concurrent commands from 3 frontends, selection independence), and a full session test combining metabolism types + nakagin design verifying 409 domain version increments. All 58 tests pass.
